scope: Exact after/before state-record permutation with nonwrapping clock progress. Verified conditional CSLib leaves, two recursive levels, and a complete small countdown. Full original CSLib execution remains unproved.

binary_provenance.V1: Used for all three server benchmark runs, the initial affected/leaf tests and complete countdown generation.
binary_provenance.V2: Final code, used for local paired setup measurement, the final state-ordering tests, retained leaf receivers, recursive CSLib chain and fresh complete-countdown receiver.
V1_to_V2_changes: Reverse the arguments of linked residual connections so ShapeBuilder appends to the growing class.
Use as_chunks for fixed record groups to satisfy Clippy.
Increase the bounded opt-in benchmark worker maximum from 16 to 32; 32 workers were not measured.
binary_provenance.final_source_hashes_apply_to: V2; V1 source differs as explicitly listed above.
binary_provenance.same_circuit_evidence: Final V2 code accepts V1 server leaves and the V1 complete root; the complete setup identity is identical.

state_linking.sources: After-state of every transition slot plus the initial boundary.
state_linking.targets: Before-state of every transition slot plus the final boundary.
state_linking.record_equality: Exact fixed Beneš permutation with Boolean selectors and one constrained XOR residual per complete output/target word.
state_linking.clock_relation: Each enabled transition has a canonical u64 before-clock and advances it by one without overflow. Disabled slots have zero clocks and states. Initial clock is strictly less than final clock.
state_linking.chain_argument: After cancelling equal padding multiplicities, c(t)-c(t-1)=[t=initial]-[t=final] with c(-1)=0. Thus exactly one enabled transition exists at each clock in the interval. Exact full-state equality links these transitions.
unchanged: All eleven earlier class matrices, quotas and transcript domains
Original CSLib program/input/output pins and reference execution
state_linking.setup_fix: Keep the growing zero-wire equivalence class first in connect(a,b), which appends b into a. This avoids repeated copying of the growing class without changing final connections.

commitment_layout.explanation: The smaller dense domain has shorter columns but more occupied lanes. Query openings carry more lane values, accounting for proof growth despite fewer committed words.
commitment_layout.security_policy: Existing Fast128 parameter files and verifier checks remain unchanged; no weakened settings or new multiset assumptions.

paired_comparison.check: Remote cmp of all 32 matching statements completed successfully; first three and later batch 256 also match retained preceding-class statements locally.

local_setup_comparison.limits: One sequential pair, no other heavy jobs. Measures the setup-construction fix locally; it is not a server throughput or full-pipeline comparison.

measurement_limits: Worker wall excludes loading, native replay and setup; includes witness generation, proving, verification and proof writes.
Whole-command times are reported separately. V1 linked setup is slower and makes the paired whole command slower despite improved worker throughput.
The final setup-construction fix is measured only locally; the final V2 server executable was not run.
Server runs use a 400 GiB resident-memory cap and no swap. Sixteen workers allow 3072 GiB virtual addresses; eight allow 1536 GiB. RSS is measured over the whole process.
Different prefix windows and worker counts are separate samples, not isolated worker-scaling comparisons.
Short conditional leaf rates exclude admission, full byte/hash workload, output and recursive aggregation, and do not establish complete CSLib proving throughput.

recursive_chain.setup_policy: Fixed original CSLib profile with fuel 16,000,000,000 and three execution leaves; compile approved class and counts before reading proof bytes.
recursive_chain.fresh_mutations: Independently flip bit 0 and bit 127 in each of 57 public words.
recursive_chain.scope: Conditional CSLib execution prefix; source admission and complete execution are outside this chain.

initial_invalid_shape.reason: Directly merging state producers caused a witness-graph cycle. Replaced with directed XOR residual gates connected to a dedicated constrained-zero class; the subsequent ordering and genuine proof tests pass.

unmeasured_attempts: Initial benchmark output directory already existed; it failed before proving and was rerun with a new directory.
A 32-worker V1 attempt failed the configured 16-worker bound before proving. No 32-worker rate is claimed.

full_run_projection.status: Not proved; not a committed runtime or budget.
